title: Recording: Hot As Sun by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio One, Morgan Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Robin Black

Paul McCartney re-recorded the McCartney song ‘Hot As Sun’ on 19 February 1970.

He had taped a version of it at his Cavendish Avenue home in December 1969, but the recording had unwanted distortion and the song required some rewriting.

McCartney wrote a new bridge and middle section, and re-recorded it at Morgan Studios on this day. He began by laying down an acoustic guitar track, followed by drums, maracas, bongos, bass guitar, electric guitar, two more acoustic guitar parts, and Hammond organ. It took several hours to complete.

A song written in about 1958 or 9 or maybe earlier, when it was one of those songs that you play now and then. The middle was added in Morgan Studio, where the track was recorded recently.
Paul McCartney, 1970
